notes: One GitHub Copilot session and one claudecode session driven concurrently in the SAME cwd by run-cell-multi.sh (partner_adapter: claudecode), observed by a single --record daemon. The daemon labels each adapter independently — disjoint ProcessMatchers (copilot ExactName{copilot} on the NATIVE child vs claudecode ExactName{claude}) and disjoint transcript roots ($COPILOT_HOME/session-state vs ~/.claude/projects), with maps.go keying every parser, PID discoverer and subagent counter on Identity.Name — so the workspace events.jsonl carries two distinct sessions, one per adapter, each with its own working->ready arc and no cross-contamination. claudecode is the partner deliberately: it and copilot are the only two agent.SubagentCounter implementers (pinned by the maps_test.go seam census), so the scenario's 'no cross-contamination of subagent counts' bullet is a live assertion rather than a vacuous one. This spec is adapter-agnostic: agentA is whichever session enters working FIRST, agentB the other, related by new_session rather than by literal id. EVERY phase anchors on a WORKING transition, never a ready, because BOTH adapters mint a born-ready proc-<PID> placeholder that never works — copilot creates session-state/<uuid>/ at launch but writes events.jsonl only on the first prompt, so processlifecycle.Scanner sees the process first. Anchoring on working skips those placeholders deterministically, and new_session on agentB skips agentA's already-matched session; a third coexisting adapter would be tolerated by the same construction. The PID seam that makes the 4-1 sibling delicate is not reached here: DiscoverPIDByCWD narrows by process NAME before cwd, so claimAwareDisambiguate only ever arbitrates same-name processes and a foreign adapter cannot steal copilot's bind. OBSERVATIONS are checked against this cell's OWN replay golden (curated from the copilot transcript), so they assert copilot's numbers, not the partner's: tokens and cost are live from assistant.message.outputTokens through the shared capacity price map, both asserted non-zero; model is NOT pinned because --model accepts only "auto" on this account and session.auto_mode_resolved picks between gpt-5-mini and claude-haiku-4.5 per turn. Asserts: two distinct sessions from two DIFFERENT adapters, each an independent working->ready arc, in one workspace.
